uncertain_terms.note: DOC-NUMBER MISMATCH: the source doc_number is Y1-R0 while the file/title say CP-Y1-r0; the doc_number was copied verbatim and not 'fixed'.
'annually bases' is a typo for 'annual basis'; translated as 'على أساس سنوي'.
'check list PI' probably means I1 (inspection 1); kept verbatim as 'PI'.
'40hg/cm2' is a typo for 40 kg/cm²; translated as '40 كجم/سم2'.
'Hyd.EPCo.' is the Hydroelectric Power Company abbreviation; kept verbatim with the expansion 'شركة الطاقة الكهرومائية'.
'dig end' is a typo for 'big end' (the big end of the connecting rod); translated as 'الطرف الكبير'.
'crosshead bosses' are the crosshead pin bosses; translated as 'رأس الصليبة'.
'equipment`s' is a typo for 'equipment'; translated as 'مهمات السلامة'.
